dt: Apply by Nov 16, 2026; advisor letter required for students and postdocs; recipients announced by the third week of January 2027
e: Travel support to the 2027 APS Global Physics Summit for DBIO members (undergraduates, graduate students, postdocs and faculty) who are first or corresponding author or presenter of a talk or poster in DBIO-sponsored sessions. Past recipients are not eligible.
n: APS DBIO Travel Awards (2027 Global Physics Summit)
